name: Term Merge Manager
description: This module saves term merge actions and reuse the rules for new terms. Also you can manage the rules
project_description:
This module extends the Term Merge Module.

 It saves all Term Merge Actions and automatically re-apply them on new terms.

 For example:

You merge "foo" and "bar" into "foobar".

The next time the term "foo" or "bar" is tried to be created on the same vocabulary, it's automatically changed into "foobar".

 This should help if you have to merge often the same terms.

 Requirements 
 
 Term Merge 
 
 Integrations 
 
 Redirect 
On "Auto redirect" setting from redirect module, redirects will be created on term merge.
